svg.title: Defect detection pipeline
svg.desc: A block diagram in two rows. Row 1: a green box for the scans in the world frame, then boxes tagged 1 Crop, 2 Separate cells, 3 Undo motion and 4 Fit the axis, joined by arrows. An arrow runs from box 4 down and back to the start of row 2. Row 2: boxes tagged 5 Residual d, 6 Threshold, 7 Cluster and 8 Classify, then a gray box for the report.
